product_metadata.title: MELLCOM 35" Electric Grill Table BBQ Grill Smokeless Grill with Non-stick Coating 1800W Indoor Bakeware with Temperature Control Fast Heat-up Bakeware with Oil Tray for Barbecue, Baking, Frying Eggs
features: [Even & Spacious Grill] The 35.4" × 9" flat surface of the baking pan ensures the even distribution of the cooking oil, prevents uneven heating of the food, and also ensures the flat and beautiful appearance of the fried eggs and pancakes. The spacious grill allows you to place steaks, barbecues, bacon, kebabs, vegetables, and other foods together, which effectively improves the efficiency of grilling.

[Adjustable Temperature & Wide Application] The 1800W fast heat-up bakeware with a 5-step temperature adjustable knob allows you to adjust the cooking temperature between 210°F and 460°F, which is suitable for fried egg, steak, vegetable, and barbecue. The unique layout of the heating element is conducive to improving the heat transfer efficiency.

[Non-stick & Easy Cleaning] The non-stick coating is applied to our smokeless grill to improve convenience. With the help of non-stick coating, food can be picked up easily and smoothly. After enjoying the delicious food, rinse with water and then wipe dry to complete the cleaning, easy and pleasant.

[Extra Oil Collecting Tray] Our table BBQ grill is equipped with an enlarged high-quality oil collecting tray. The detachable oil collecting tray, which measures 4.3'' * 5.5'' * 1.38'', is a good choice to collect excess oil. The oil collecting tray has an excellent performance in preventing oil, is very easy to clean, and effectively avoids oil residue.

[Easy Use & Sale Service]. Insert the plug into the socket and adjust the temperature knob to use our electric bakeware. We aim to provide high-quality products and services, if you have any questions, please contact us, we'd like to help you.
